change: Remove cached full-value spans and register levels from internal token quantities; install macro bodies as single-span sources; share the expansion-depth guard with expressions.
scope: Ordinary release only. Seven paired full-process repetitions at the largest size for each of the eighteen existing cases; selected cases have twenty-one paired repetitions without pdfTeX. Allocation diagnostics run separately from CPU timing.

kernels.name: spelling
kernels.adaptation: Definitions unchanged. Bootstrap ifcanspell with let instead of loading plain newif. The preceding aesthetic macro needs an accent and is omitted.

kernels.name: today
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Define plain's space macro and assign calendar parameters explicitly.

kernels.name: talks
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Consume expanded sentences in definitions rather than typesetting them.

kernels.name: contentsentry
kernels.adaptation: Retain the complete write payload in a parameterized macro invoked in edef. Stringified line/dotfill names and braces are never executed. Bootstrap pageno with countdef.

kernels.name: maketable
kernels.adaptation: Retain the bracketed-title and paragraph-delimited signature; replace the box/display body with edef of both complete payloads.

expansion.validation: Every record compares its expanded definition with independently generated expected tokens; comparison and expected definition construction are timed.
expansion.storage: Immutable definitions and token lists are reclaimed after their last semantic owner; bump chunks and value IDs are reused. Interned names remain session-owned.

confirmations.scope: Alternating full-process child user-plus-system CPU comparison of simplifications against a7f8be0. Input reads, construction, execution and checksum output are timed. One warmup precedes twenty-one retained repetitions; every checksum is verified.

allocation_scope: Engine construction and execution; requested heap bytes exclude host input, stack, allocator overhead, and pdfTeX memory.
